en.headline: Traditional sauce maker Kui Lee to close after 90 years
en.dek: The family business, established in 1936, will shut its Wan Chai shop once remaining stock is sold after its Kwu Tung factory was cleared for the Northern Metropolis.
body: Kui Lee Sauce and Preserved Fruit will cease operations after nearly 90 years once it sells through the remaining inventory at its Wan Chai retail shop, the company confirmed.

An employee told the South China Morning Post that production at the Kwu Tung factory had already halted after authorities cleared the site and a nearby village under a land resumption operation for the Northern Metropolis.
Founded in 1936 and run by three generations, the firm has been known for products made entirely in Hong Kong. The closure ends one of the city’s last traditional sauce makers in that area.
The company said all remaining stock is now at the Wan Chai outlet, which will close permanently after the inventory is exhausted.

zh.headline: 經營九十年醬園鉅利將結業 古洞廠房因北都收地停產
zh.dek: 1936年成立的家族醬園，在古洞廠房因北部都會區收地清拆後，灣仔零售店售罄存貨即永久結業。
body: 鉅利醬園及蜜餜確認，將在灣仔零售店售罄餘下存貨後結業，結束近九十年的經營。
一名職員向南華早報表示，古洞廠房的生產已經停止，當局因北部都會區土地收回行動清拆了廠房及附近村屋。
這間由三代經營、1936年創立的醬園，一向以百分百香港製造為人所知。結業意味本港其中一間傳統醬園在該區消失。
公司指，所有剩餘存貨現時存放在灣仔店舖，售罄後將永久關門。
